0022600189.text: The Nuggets (3-3) are 4th in the Northwest and 10th in the West, 2 games back in their division, and they enter on a one-game losing streak after going 2-1 on the road. The Pacers (2-6) are 12th in the East and 4 games back in the Central, on a five-game losing streak with an 0-4 home record. This regular-season NBA Mexico City Game is at a neutral site in Mexico City, with Denver as the designated road team, and the 2026-27 season series has no games yet, while Denver won the 2025-26 series 2-0, including a 135-120 win in Indianapolis on December 3, 2025. Out for Denver are DeMar DeRozan (back, spasms), Julian Strawther (knee, sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring), and out for Indiana are Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), Kelly Oubre Jr. (calf bruise), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain).
